title: Tradewinds Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Luxury home in Seaside, FL. Next to the iconic chapel. Walk to the beach, pool, and town. Sleeps 8, Tradewinds.
description_expanded: Description568 FOREST STREET2 QUEENS, 1 TWIN W/TRUNDLE BED, 1 QUEEN MURPHY BEDLuxury Designer Home in the Heart of SeasideIntroducing Tradewinds, a stunning luxury designer home new to the Seaside rental market and beautifully renovated from top to bottom with exceptional custom detail throughout. Perfectly located next to the iconic Seaside Chapel, this one-of-a-kind home blends refined coastal elegance with thoughtful family-friendly design—making it an ideal retreat for discerning guests seeking comfort, style, and an unbeatable location.Inviting Outdoor Spaces & Charming Curb AppealTradewinds sleeps up to eight guests and offers multiple exceptional outdoor living areas. Upon arrival, guests are welcomed by an open front porch with three rocking chairs, ideal for slow mornings with coffee. The porch overlooks a generous fenced side yard featuring a custom-built double swing, perfect for children and relaxed outdoor moments. Completing the outdoor experience is a truly spa-like enclosed outdoor shower, designed to feel indulgent and serene after a day at the beach.Luxurious First-Floor Bedrooms & Spa-Inspired BathsThe first floor features two beautifully appointed bedrooms along with a custom-built sleeping nook. The queen primary bedroom offers a pencil post bed, sofa lounger, luxurious linens, flat-screen TV, and a walk-in closet. The private marble primary bathroom is a standout, featuring a single vanity, mounted flat-screen TV, deep soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed marble walk-in shower with rain shower head and wand. A private door leads directly to the grand enclosed outdoor shower, complete with rain shower head, shower wand, and built-in bench—creating a true spa retreat. The adjacent queen guest bedroom is equally refined, with designer furnishings, stunning linens, a corner chair, flat-screen TV, and a private ensuite bath featuring marble finishes, a single vanity, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with built-in bench, rain shower, and wand.Custom Sleeping Nook & Family-Friendly DetailsTucked beneath the staircase is a thoughtfully designed built-in twin bunk nook with a twin trundle, a favorite space for younger guests. This cozy area includes privacy shades for the upper bunk, a mounted flat-screen TV, recessed lighting, and custom millwork—perfectly positioned between both bedrooms for added peace of mind.Chef’s Kitchen, Bar Area & Open-Concept LivingAt the top of the stairs, a custom built-in bar area welcomes you with a dedicated coffee station featuring a Moccamaster, beverage refrigerator, and an ice maker producing coveted Sonic-style ice. Adjacent is the home’s stunning open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space. The chef’s kitchen features a large marble center island with seating for four, top-of-the-line appliances including a Wolf six-burner gas range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, deep galley sink, and a wall of windows overlooking the side yard and Seaside Chapel. The dining area includes a round expandable table seating six to eight guests, while the living room offers designer furnishings, ample seating, a large mounted flat-screen TV, and a queen Murphy bed. A convenient half bath completes this level.Screened Porch Living with Views of the Seaside ChapelOne of the most loved spaces in the home is the expansive screened-in outdoor living porch located just off the bar area. Designed for both relaxation and entertaining, this space features two outdoor sofas, two oversized loungers, a large mounted outdoor TV, and an outdoor dining table seating eight guests. Overlooking the fenced yard and the Seaside Chapel, this porch is perfect for movie nights, game days, and memorable gatherings.An Exceptional Seaside Home for Families, Couples & Special OccasionsWith its prime chapel-side location, luxurious finishes, and thoughtful layout, Tradewinds is ideal for young families, two couples traveling together, or guests attending a Seaside wedding or special event. Rarely does a home of this caliber, location, and design become available—making Tradewinds a truly unforgettable Seaside vacation experience.* For rent in summer only. 5NT minimum for Summers. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,833 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceAccess to the private Seaside residential beach at East Ruskin Pavilion7-minute walk (528 yards) to beach accessOutdoor fireplace (decorative use only)Ice maker with Sonic-style iceOutdoor living and dining area with mounted televisionPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehicles and are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitSTR23-002169
